title: Studio 重构后续：退役「软件包」开发视图（无 face 参数的 PackagesPage），动作只留在 Studio「⋯」菜单与「设置 > 软件包」
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Sub-issue of #36890 · Source: Q3 in the #37139 dev report 7177958131. Card #37139's own Notes defer this to the maintainer after it lands. Part of #36890.

Blocked-by: #37456 (#37424 phase 1; this card is #37424 phase 2, folded with Setup → Packages slimming, tasks 8 + 12)
Re-parented (2026-11-26T06:49Z): moved from #36890 to #37424 on the maintainer's order 「Studio 重构专题 的任务是不是和可以合并到新专题，原来的专题关掉」 (2026-11-26T06:45Z, area thread of seat `repo:objectstack#5`).

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：旧的「软件包开发视图」页面撤掉。它原来的动作现在分在两处：导入、新建、查看、停用、删除在「设置 > 软件包」；编辑信息、导出、复制、还原、收编散落项、新建软件包在 Studio 顶栏的「⋯」菜单。
- 为什么做：两套入口做同一件事，以后改功能要改两处，而且行为已经出现不一致：开发视图的「还原」不会先确认，菜单里的会。
- 出错会怎样：如果有动作漏搬，用户就找不到它；所以退役前要逐项核对，包括「发布」。撤回即恢复旧页面。
- 要你做什么：无（已裁决）。

## Ruling
The maintainer's words, verbatim, in seat repo:objectstack#4's session: 「接受你的建议」. This was the answer to the seat's presentation of Q3. The seat recommended retiring the development face only after the Q2 card (#37400) lands, so that a Studio-only author keeps a way to create a package.

## What
- Retire the development face: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` rendered without a `face` param. Any address that reaches it lands on a working page instead: Setup → Packages for a holder of the Setup pair, otherwise the current package in Studio. Follow the redirect pattern #36909 uses for retired addresses.
- Before removing anything, map every development-face action to its new door. That covers Edit, Publish, Revert, Export, Duplicate, Adopt loose items and Import. Publish is expected to sit in Studio's draft bar; confirm it. Record the mapping in the PR body.
- Drop the strings and code that only the development face reads. Per the released-key rules, a key that shipped in a release is retired through the narrowing route, never silently.

## Done when
- Every development-face action has a working door elsewhere, and each one is pinned.
- No address strands a user.
- The development face's code and its unreleased strings are gone.
